author: Blender Guru
description:
In this video you'll learn how to use geometry nodes to make a procedural Backrooms level in Blender. 

Download textures and finished .blend file: https://www.poliigon.com/backrooms
Blender Guru Academy: http://www.blenderguru.com/academy

My PC is a #DellProMaxDell (T2 Pro Max) with a #Nvidia 6000 RTX Blackwell Workstation Edition.
